turns.text: It's not a formal yes, I will allow this.
turns.zh: 它不是那种正式的「好的，我允许这件事」。

turns.text: And notice the way he added no problem.
turns.zh: 注意他加「没问题」的方式。

turns.text: It means this is not difficult for me.
turns.zh: 意思是这对我来说不难。

turns.text: It's not a problem at all.
